Install OpenClaw (Clawdbot) on Hostinger VPS - Quick Setup Guide
Deploy your personal 24/7 AI assistant on Hostinger VPS using the one-click Docker template. OpenClaw connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, and Discord, running entirely on your infrastructure.

What You'll Do:
Deploy OpenClaw via Hostinger's Docker Manager catalog (2-3 minutes)
Configure your Gateway Token and optional API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini)
Connect WhatsApp by scanning a QR code
Access your AI assistant through a web interface at your-vps-ip:port

https://www.hostinger.com/vps/docker/clawdbot

This tutorial covers both the Clawdbot / Openclaw Hostinger Docker Template and The CLI method (SSH into the VPS from Local Machine)

Finally the tutorial ends with showing how to connect the VPS to a remote desktop machine and access clawdbot there!
